units.source_text: 他并不打算做个性变态者。

en.t: He had no intention of becoming a sexual deviant.

units.source_text: 可就是那“精神强奸”，怎么都让人觉得别扭。

en.t: But that phrase, "mental rape," somehow felt awkward no matter how he looked at it.

units.source_text: 仿佛吃了没加盐的生蒟蒻。

en.t: It was like eating raw konjac without any salt.

units.source_text: 给对方伤害之前，先侮辱了自己。

en.t: Before hurting the other person, he would first be humiliating himself.

units.source_text: 而且，连精神性性病也必须接受，这究竟是怎么一回事呢？

en.t: And besides, what was this business about having to accept even some kind of mental venereal disease?

units.source_text: 不就是踩一脚，踹一脚吗？

en.t: Wasn't it just a matter of stepping on someone, giving them a kick?

units.source_text: 女人的黏膜难道就那么虚弱，我扫一眼就会喷血吗？

en.t: Were women's mucous membranes really so fragile that they would spurt blood if I so much as glanced at them?
